name: agent-notes
about: A note while an agent works (11 Nov 2026, agents/runner.rs passes_now): in a Bypass Code chat on lab-sandbox, an agent is sent on a task of several steps, and while it works a note for it is put to Chat. The note goes to the agent's Claude Code at once (said so: "at its next step"), it's read there, and the agent answers once: one row in its panel, one report card, one answer. Then a second request once it's done: its next turn, reported by itself. The timing is the real agent's, so the checks that need the note to land mid-work are soft; on a --fake lab the stand-in agent is done at once and the note is simply its next turn (the plumbing still runs).

steps.note: Bypass permissions, as in the report that led here: no cards.

args.brief: Add a tablespoons-to-millilitres function to src/convert.js (1 tbsp = 15 ml), add a test for it, run the tests, then tick the item off in TODO.md.
args.title: Add tablespoons

fake.content: On it: I've sent an agent to lab-sandbox.

steps.ask: Add tablespoons to convert.js (1 tbsp = 15 ml), add a test for it, run the tests, and tick it off in TODO.md. Take it one step at a time, and read each file before you change it.

args.text: Keep the existing function names as they are: that's on purpose.

fake.content: Passed that on: the agent in lab-sandbox takes it in at its next step.
Done. The agent added tablespoons with a test and kept the function names.

steps.ask: Tell the agent to keep the existing function names as they are: that's on purpose.

steps.note: The note reached the agent while it worked: handed to it now. Soft: an agent that had finished already takes it as its next turn instead.
The chat's answer, and the agent's row with the note on its way or read.
One report card for the work and the note, never one each.
The note joined the turn working: one row. Soft: an agent that had finished already has a second row for it.
One Agent done card and one answer under it.

args.brief: Add a line about tablespoons to README.md.
args.title: Mention tablespoons in the README

fake.content: On it: I've passed that to the agent in lab-sandbox.

steps.ask: Now add a line about tablespoons to the README.

steps.note: A request once it's done is its next turn, with a report of its own: two cards now.
